gui.aeautopatterns.providers.continue.he: Upload in selection order. When full, continue only to later selected providers marked crafting-only. Applies to crafting, stonecutting and smithing patterns. Unselected providers are never used. Pause when full and resume when space is available.
gui.aeautopatterns.providers.crafting.he: This terminal only uploads crafting, stonecutting and smithing patterns here. Processing patterns are excluded. This rule does not restrict players or other devices.
gui.aeautopatterns.providers.details.hel: Use the checkbox for multiple selection; click the card for details and pattern restrictions. # indicates upload order.
gui.aeautopatterns.ignore_components.hel: Analyze the cursor target using its item type and default components, ignoring added energy, damage and names. Recipe inputs and encoded patterns remain exact.
gui.aeautopatterns.ignore_components.tri: Disable for specific armor trims or other component targets. Toggling reanalyzes the selected cursor target; disabling restores its original components.
gui.aeautopatterns.pending.title: Needs attention
gui.aeautopatterns.pending.help: Click to preview recipes, use the arrows and confirm. Scroll to browse this list.
gui.aeautopatterns.pending.unresolved_he: Click to locate this material in dependencies, then adjust its recipe, input or external-supply setting.
gui.aeautopatterns.issue.cycle: Cause: dependency cycle. Choose another recipe or external supply.
gui.aeautopatterns.issue.locate: Click the bottom message to locate the material
gui.aeautopatterns.search.jei_drop: Drag a JEI ghost item here to set the analysis target
gui.aeautopatterns.tree.title: Recipe tree
gui.aeautopatterns.upload.help: Send each encoded pattern to the selected AE pattern provider. Patterns stay in this terminal if the provider is full or offline.
gui.aeautopatterns.processing.help: Generate furnace, blasting, smoking and campfire patterns. Toggling reanalyzes.
gui.aeautopatterns.processing.fuel: Configure fuel and machines separately. Existing patterns are still reused.
gui.aeautopatterns.tree.select: Select a material to inspect and adjust its route.
gui.aeautopatterns.tree.help: Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · Select to edit · Esc closes panel / returns
gui.aeautopatterns.tree.stop.LIMIT: Display limit of 4096 nodes reached. Some children are not expanded.
gui.aeautopatterns.tree.stop.CYCLE: Cycle on this path; expansion stopped.
